clusters.reason: All three findings describe the same underlying vulnerability where a sponsor sets sponsorRecipient to a precomputed future Raffle clone CREATE address during createRaffle/initialize, bypassing isRaffle and _isProtocolDestination screening before the sibling clone is deployed and subsequently locking sponsorProceeds and stranding the returned prize NFT in releaseSponsorPrize.

All four findings describe the same underlying vulnerability in Raffle._update (Raffle.sol:498) where minting or transferring a ticket (via buyEntries, transferFrom, or safeTransferFrom) to a precomputed future Raffle clone CREATE address bypasses _isProtocolDestination(to, address(prizeToken)) and ERC721 receiver checks while to.code.length == 0, permanently stranding the ticket and its prize or refund claim once the sibling Raffle clone is deployed.
